text:
Alex K: Heads up 1: found ~0.5% of billing events with no provenance_id coming from chunked requests when we hydrate prefixes from KV. Repro in staging.
Maria T: Can you share the log snippet and whether it's only chunked paths or also streaming?
Alex K: Only chunked + cache hit path. Streaming with fresh prefixes looks fine. Log shows finalizer getting provenance_id=null and source="kv-prefix-cache". Example:
```
INFO finalizer: received event {request_id: "r_42", provenance_id: null, source: "kv-prefix-cache", shard: 3}
```
Dan P: Quick theory: KV hydration returns prefix bytes but doesn't copy provenance header into the per-chunk envelope. Short-term mitigation: when hydrating from KV, synth a provenance_id (prefix) and tag envelope with provenance_origin="kv-hydrate" and confidence="synthetic".
Sophie L: That keeps billing pipeline intact but we must never treat synthetic IDs as final attribution without reconciliation. Need audit/ops visibility.
Maria T: I can patch the KV shim to inject provenance_id if missing. Where exactly should this live? Tokenizer-level fanout currently composes chunk envelopes.
Alex K: Patch plan: KV hydrate shim will inject provenance_id + provenance_origins array. Example envelope sketch I sent Dan earlier:
```
{"envelope":"{request_id:\"r_42\",provenance_id:\"pv_stub_123\",provenance_origins:[\"kv-hydrate\"],chunks:[...]}"}
```
Dan P: Note: adding that metadata ~+120 bytes/event; tradeoff vs doing expensive backfills. Also update billing reconciler to mark confidence for synthetic provenance.
Sophie L: Add metric: finalizer.synthetic_provenance_rate and alert when >0.1% over 1h. Ops playbook: inspect sample request traces and run stitch job.
IngestBot: Alert created: metric(finalizer.null_provenance_rate)=0.52% at 2026-03-21T14:02:13Z; ticket #ING-3982
Maria T: I'll open a small PR for the KV shim hotfix with unit tests that simulate chunk replay and KV hits. Hotfix rollout: enable in staging first.
Alex K: Long-term RFC: unify provenance contract across runtime components, require provenance header at ingest (fail-fast unless a controlled shim is enabled), and design a compact provenance registry (id -> fingerprint) to avoid large indexes.
Dan P: Long-term also: runtime enforcement to prevent header dropping, and an opt-in synthesis mode for legacy clients during migration.
Sophie L: For audits, plan a reconciliation job: retroactively stitch synthetic IDs against request fingerprints using model telemetry and token time indexes. Flag any estimated assignments in billing exports.
Maria T: Action items: 1) Hotfix KV shim (Maria), 2) RFC + reconciliation plan (Alex), 3) Registry/backfill sketch (Dan), 4) Ops alert/dashboards + playbook (Sophie). I'll include tests and rollout notes in the PR.
Alex K: I'll draft the RFC today and include storage sizing for the registry and the reconciliation throughput estimate. Target: hotfix deployed to staging within 48h, canary to prod following validation.
Dan P: For backfill: best-effort join between request fingerprint, tokenizer offsets, and model telemetry to produce estimated token attributions; mark as estimated; run asynchronously.
Sophie L: +1. Also add a short-lived sampling job to validate synthetic vs native attribution quality for the first week after rollout.
Alex K: Thanks all. Please react with :thumbsup: if this summary looks right.
Maria T: Reacted :thumbsup:. I'll send PR link once ready.
